Privacy Policy

No Cookies

This website does not use cookies, tracking pixels, or any form of client-side storage other than localStorage, which is used exclusively to save your editor preferences (theme, text, settings). No data from localStorage is transmitted to any server.

No Tracking

We do not use analytics services, tracking scripts, or fingerprinting. We have no interest in who you are or what you do on this site.

Server Logs

Like every web server, Caddy records basic access logs (requested URL, timestamp, IP address, user agent) for operational security and debugging. These logs are retained for a maximum of 7 days and are not shared with third parties.

External Services

This site is fully self-contained. No external fonts, scripts, or resources are loaded from third-party servers.

Your Rights

You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data we may hold. To exercise these rights, contact us at hi@koalastuff.net.
